About this item

  • Ultra Sharp Professional Edge：Each knife in the imarku kitchen knife set is carefully hand-polished by skilled craftsmen with a 15° double bevel edge and 2.3mm blade thickness for exceptional cutting precision. These ultra sharp kitchen knives glide effortlessly through vegetables, fruits, fish, and meat, delivering a smooth and professional cooking experience
  • Essential 3-Piece Knife Set for Every Kitchen：This professional chef knife set includes the most practical knives for daily cooking: 8" Chef Knife – versatile for chopping, slicing, and dicing 7" Nakiri Knife – ideal for cutting meat and large ingredients 3.5" Paring Knife – perfect for peeling and precision tasks Whether you're preparing dinner at home or cooking professionally, this multi-purpose kitchen knives set handles almost every cutting task with ease
  • Premium Japanese Stainless Steel：Crafted from High-Carbon Japanese stainless steel, these cooking knives reach 57±1 HRC hardness after advanced vacuum heat treatment and tempering, providing excellent edge retention, durability, and corrosion resistance. For long-lasting performance, we recommend hand washing and drying after use
  • Ergonomic Pakkawood Handle：Designed with a beautiful ergonomic pakkawood handle, this chef knife set offers a comfortable grip and balanced control. The well-balanced structure reduces hand fatigue during extended use, making these knives perfect for both home cooks and professional chefs
  • Elegant Gift Box – Perfect Gift for Cooking Lovers：This kitchen knife set with gift box comes in a premium designer package, making it an ideal gift for home chefs, cooking enthusiasts, culinary students, or professional cooks. A great choice for housewarming, weddings, birthdays, Christmas, or Father's Day gifts
  • Reliable Customer Support：At imarku, customer satisfaction is our priority. Our support team responds within 24 hours to help with any questions about your kitchen knives set.So just feel free to contact us anytime

From the brand

  2. About imarku

    Founded in 1949 by a Japanese family of bladesmiths, each knife is crafted through 108 traditional forging steps. Hand-folded steel forms 32,768 layers for balanced strength and durability. A clay-tempered edge, finished at 15° and hand-polished with 3000-grit stones, delivers precise, dependable performance. Trusted by professional kitchens since entering the U.S. in 2016.

Product description

  • Our Story: A Legacy Forged in Steel | 鋼に刻まれた伝統

Since 1949, our journey has been guided by the hands of a Japanese family of master bladesmiths. For generations, we have honored a single, unwavering philosophy: to forge tools that are not merely used, but trusted to perform. This deep-rooted heritage is the soul of every knife we create.

  • The 108 Steps of Mastery | 匠の技、108の工程

True excellence lies in the discipline of the process. Each of our knives is born from 108 traditional forging steps (108の伝統鍛造工程), a meticulous ritual passed down through our family. At its heart is the ancient technique of hand-folding steel, which builds an astonishing 32,768 layers (32,768層) into the blade's core.

How customer reviews and ratings work

So I resurrect my old knife block and purchased a set of steak knives without serration

    Meet cleavers are not just for cutting meat. I have had this knif for around a year. This is the best knife I have ever used for cutting ALL my food, not just meat. All the reviews that wrote that they can't get a sharp edge on it, don't know how to sharpen a knife! This is one of the easiest knives I've ever sharpened. I use a chefs rod sharpener and it come out very sharp EVERY time. If you don't know how to sharpen a knife, that is one thing. But don't write that it is a cheap knife that won't get a sharp edge just because you don't know how to sharpen a high quility carbon steel cleaver. And the review that said that it is to heavy, that he will be using it instead to chop wood, doesn't realize that all good quality cleavers are heavy like this. News flash. This is a meat cleaver. If you want a ax, go buy an ax. I have used it at least sixty times to cut food for dinner. This knife is made of fantastic high carbon stainless steel. It should be at least three times the price. That's how good this knife is. It also comes with a thick, good quality leather sheath. It is relitvly easy to sharpen. It really holds an edge incredably, once sharpened. The steel is not to hard where it becomes brittle. It's also not to soft where it won't hold an edge. The hardness is just the correct balance. It holds an edge better than my $150 great brand camping knife. Once the food is cut on my chopping block, I can easily scrap up the food onto the side of the knife, having the blade go under the side of my hand and pushing it onto the knife then picking up the food and putting it into a bowl, frying pan ect., just the way the chefs do in Chinese restaurants. It is much more efficient that way. That is what makes this a much better option for cutting ALL my food, rather than using a regular chefs knife. I know. I used to be a chef in a five star restaurant in CT. This knife is just as good as the expensive $140 knives that were bought from a restayrant supply company for the restaurant I worked at . So, buy it. You won't be disappointed with it!!!

About this Item

  • Ultra Sharp Professional Edge：Each knife in the imarku kitchen knife set is carefully hand-polished by skilled craftsmen with a 15° double bevel edge and 2.3mm blade thickness for exceptional cutting precision. These ultra sharp kitchen knives glide effortlessly through vegetables, fruits, fish, and meat, delivering a smooth and professional cooking experience
  • Essential 3-Piece Knife Set for Every Kitchen：This professional chef knife set includes the most practical knives for daily cooking: 8" Chef Knife – versatile for chopping, slicing, and dicing 7" Nakiri Knife – ideal for cutting meat and large ingredients 3.5" Paring Knife – perfect for peeling and precision tasks Whether you're preparing dinner at home or cooking professionally, this multi-purpose kitchen knives set handles almost every cutting task with ease
  • Premium Japanese Stainless Steel：Crafted from High-Carbon Japanese stainless steel, these cooking knives reach 57±1 HRC hardness after advanced vacuum heat treatment and tempering, providing excellent edge retention, durability, and corrosion resistance. For long-lasting performance, we recommend hand washing and drying after use
  • Ergonomic Pakkawood Handle：Designed with a beautiful ergonomic pakkawood handle, this chef knife set offers a comfortable grip and balanced control. The well-balanced structure reduces hand fatigue during extended use, making these knives perfect for both home cooks and professional chefs
  • Elegant Gift Box – Perfect Gift for Cooking Lovers：This kitchen knife set with gift box comes in a premium designer package, making it an ideal gift for home chefs, cooking enthusiasts, culinary students, or professional cooks. A great choice for housewarming, weddings, birthdays, Christmas, or Father's Day gifts
  • Reliable Customer Support：At imarku, customer satisfaction is our priority. Our support team responds within 24 hours to help with any questions about your kitchen knives set.So just feel free to contact us anytime

Product Description

Upgrade your kitchen with the imarku 3-piece professional kitchen knife set, designed for both home cooks and professional chefs who value performance, durability, and style. This versatile kitchen knives set includes an 8-inch chef knife, 7-inch nakiri knife, and 3.5-inch paring knife, covering the essential cutting tasks in everyday cooking. From slicing vegetables to trimming meat or peeling fruits, these knives deliver precision and efficiency. Each blade is crafted from premium Japanese stainless steel and finished with a razor-sharp 15° edge, ensuring exceptional cutting performance and long-lasting sharpness. The advanced vacuum heat treatment process enhances durability and corrosion resistance. The knives are paired with a beautifully designed ergonomic pakkawood handle, providing a comfortable grip and excellent balance for effortless control. Packaged in an elegant gift box, this chef knife set also makes a perfect gift for cooking enthusiasts, culinary students, and professional chefs. Experience the perfect combination of sharpness, craftsmanship, and design with imarku.
